description: Dart source code defining the AnalyticsScreen widget, a Flutter UI screen for displaying quiz analytics, KPIs, filters, and per-quiz performance breakdown. It leverages Riverpod for state management and Flutter Material components.

classes.name: AnalyticsScreen
classes.description: A Flutter consumer widget that displays quiz analytics, including KPIs, filter options, and per-quiz performance details.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree for the AnalyticsScreen, displaying data based on the current state and user-selected filters.

methods.name: _filterBar
methods.description: Builds the filter bar UI allowing category selection, date range filtering, and preset range buttons.

methods.name: _isSameRange
methods.description: Checks if the current filter's date range matches a preset range of specified days.

methods.name: _presetChip
methods.description: Creates a ChoiceChip widget for preset date ranges like 7d, 14d, etc.

methods.name: _allChip
methods.description: Creates an 'All' range chip to reset the date filter to encompass all data.

methods.name: _rangeLabel
methods.description: Formats the start and end DateTime into a string label for display.

methods.name: _kpiCard
methods.description: Creates a styled card widget for displaying individual KPIs with an icon, value, and title.

methods.name: _quizStatTile
methods.description: Builds a widget tile displaying performance stats for a specific quiz.

methods.name: _miniBar
methods.description: Creates a mini bar graph visualization for score percentages.

methods.name: _pill
methods.description: Builds a small pill-shaped label widget for statuses or counts.

methods.name: _emptyStateFiltered
methods.description: Displays a UI message when no data matches current filters, with an option to reset filters.
